The Garden NPC class is not currently placed/spawned anywhere in the live world -- no street/hub NPC seed data references it (confirmed via a repo-wide grep for "Garden(" outside garden.dart's own definition), so this real harvest logic is currently inert, the same placement gap already documented for ToolVendor/StreetSpirit in a prior pass. Also (a second, independent route): sold by the real, unmodified 'produce' StreetSpirit vendor-stock list (coUserver/lib/entities/npcs/vendors/vendor.dart, case 'produce'), assigned to 118 streets via real per-street vendorType data in coUserver/lib/entities/npcs/vendors/vendors.json. Neither Garden nor StreetSpirit (nor any of its regional subclasses) is currently placed/spawned anywhere in the live world -- no street/hub NPC seed data references either class (confirmed via a repo-wide grep for both class names outside their own definition files). NPC world-placement is a separate future item from this pass, which converts icon/sprite visual assets only.
